verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an Agentic Feed API that lets merchants upload product data in batches of up to 200 items. That data is mapped and synchronized to AI platforms such as OpenAI and Meta, with one request able to target multiple platforms. Marketing material adds that a single feed adapts to each platform with real-time catalog and inventory data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the feed sync works, and detail on feed schema, update cadence and the full list of supported agent surfaces beyond OpenAI and Meta.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can publish my product or service catalog into agent surfaces through a documented feed or import API so AI agents can discover what I sell

citations.quote: The mapped data is synchronized with AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta. A single item can target multiple platforms in one request.
You upload product data in batches of up to 200 items.
Deliver a single product feed that automatically adapts to each AI platform's requirements, with accurate, real-time catalog and inventory data.
